title: Colts coaches weigh in on Anthony Richardson’s abrupt return to the starting lineup

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Colts coaches weigh in on Anthony Richardson’s abrupt return to the starting lineup
sources.description: Colts QB Anthony Richardson will be reinserted into a challenging starting situation, but will get an opportunity to prove himself again—and his complete story in Indianapolis still remains unwritten.
